decision.why_incumbent_is_retained: No current family-specific material evidence justifies adding EOS, and the task explicitly requires simpler no-EOS when material support is absent.

historical_nontransfer_evidence.interpretation: Historical results are scale- and horizon-sensitive. EOS-isolated was worse at 268K and only ~0.00253 BPB better at 1M in one matched seed; matched generation did not terminate on EOS. Cross-document packing improved utilization but materially worsened 1M content BPB. This does not establish material EOS support for TOK-242.
historical_nontransfer_evidence.scope: DATA-25 project-authored corpus with canonical byte tokenizer; historical only, not a substitute for TOK-241

reason: TOK-242 is defined under the tokenizer family selected by TOK-241, but no terminal TOK-241 PR, branch, commit, artifact, or prior-result authority is available at this source cut. Running family-specific ~500K boundary probes by assuming byte would violate the dependency and could mis-size vocabulary/embedding tax or checkpoint compatibility.
unblock_requirements: terminal TOK-241 family decision and immutable tokenizer artifact identity
same terminal research corpus identity and selection-validation authority used by TOK-241
family-specific deterministic EOS/EOD ID reservation/addition semantics if candidate B is representable
parameter-matched ~500K A/B probes with equal source-content exposure across paired seeds
